# netbox_user (Data Source)

A NetBox user (users.user).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/user/):

> A user represents an individual account in NetBox. Users authenticate to access the application, and may be granted permissions either directly or through their assigned [groups](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/group/). Each user can hold one or more API [tokens](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/token/) for use with the REST and GraphQL APIs.
>
> NetBox extends Django's stock user model to support multiple API tokens per user, configurable [object permissions](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/objectpermission/), and integration with [remote authentication backends](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/administration/authentication/overview/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_user" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `username` (String)
- `username_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the username.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of is_active.
- `date_joined` (String) When the account was created.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String)
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the groups the user belongs to.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user may log in.
- `last_login` (String) When the user last logged in; null until the first login.
- `last_name` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the user. Never returned by NetBox, so changes made outside Terraform go unnoticed.
- `url` (String)
